lines.text: Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem fears Gibeon's peace with Israel and gets four kings to join him in attacking Gibeon.
Gibeon begs Joshua at Gilgal for help, and Joshua comes with his whole army.
The LORD tells Joshua not to be afraid, and Israel strikes the Amorites by surprise after marching all night from Shiloh.
As the armies flee down from Beth-horon, the LORD throws large hailstones on them, and the swords of Israel kill more than the hailstones.

wrong_details.wrong: the swords of Israel kill more than the hailstones
wrong_details.true: more were killed by the hailstones than by the swords of the Israelites

lines.text: Joshua asks the sun and moon to stand still, and the LORD fights for Israel before Joshua returns to Gilgal.
